core_obligations: Construct a polynomial-size set-multilinear branching program encoding the arc-pairing process.
Prove arc-full-rank by specializing auxiliary variables to a chosen pairing.
Prove the many-violations bound through the two jump cases and the complete chessboard random-walk analysis.
Combine induction on formula depth with partial-coloring violations and relative rank to establish the advertised low-depth formula bound.
